svg.title: Water Politics, Fatah Raids and Escalation Before the Six-Day War (1964–May 1967)
svg.desc: High-precision 1:10m GIS historical atlas map of pre-June 1967 Israel, the Jordanian-ruled West Bank, Egyptian-administered Gaza, and Syrian Golan Heights, showing the 1964 Israeli National Water Carrier, Arab Headwater Diversion Project, Fatah guerrilla raids, the November 1966 As-Samu raid, and the 7 April 1967 air battle.
